---
name: Task
about: Track a discrete piece of work (refactor, tuning, docs, chore)
title: "[TASK] <short summary>"
labels: chore
assignees: ''
---

**Goal**
One sentence: what will be true when this task is done?

**Scope**
- [ ] Sub-task 1
- [ ] Sub-task 2
- [ ] Sub-task 3

**Out of scope**
Anything explicitly *not* part of this task, to prevent creep.

**Files / modules involved**
e.g. `detect.cpp`, `helpers.cpp`, `config.h`

**Definition of done**
- [ ] Code compiles and flashes without warnings
- [ ] Tested on hardware (board variant / scenario)
- [ ] No regression in existing detections (specify which were re-tested)
- [ ] Docs / comments updated if behaviour changed

**Dependencies / blockers**
Related issues, pending hardware, or prerequisite PRs.
